articles.title: Sir Ranulph Fiennes receiving 'appropriate care,' police confirm - as force insist there are 'no immediate safeguarding concerns'
articles.description: Police have batted away mounting alarm about the welfare of Sir Ranulph Fiennes, insisting the explorer is receiving "appropriate" care and that there are "no safeguarding concerns".
